summary: P2-04AD-1 analogue input module arrangement: mounting, interface and service-space coordination.
description: P2-04AD-1 is the drawing identifier for analogue input module in AutomationDirect's Productivity2000 PAC collection. An analogue input module brings continuously varying sensor information into a controller. Its physical connectors and mounting arrangement are different questions from the signal range configured in the control program.

For example, in a process-control panel receiving transmitter signals, use the P2-04AD-1 reference to coordinate field-signal terminals, module removal and the controller connection. Show the neighbouring equipment and the connection route so the installer can understand the intended arrangement.

Use the reviewed native drawing identified as PLC Families/P2000/P2-04AD-1.DWG for the exact physical details. Locate the named file in its original manufacturer archive. Manufacturer drawing previews are shown only when an exact approved source is available. Any illustrative 3D view is a separate concept and is not to scale; use the selected manufacturer documents for dimensions, ratings and installation details.
